With Pinterest-worthy decor and calm, green surroundings, this place is a must-visit place for those who like to enjoy good books while munching on amazing food.</div></div></div></section><section id="5bec7b5dbd35a5198ad70b56"><h2 class="styled-components__StyledSectionTitle-sc-w4s7c5-18 gOrzBX"><div class="">What Makes It Awesome</div></h2><div class="styled-components__StyledSectionContent-sc-w4s7c5-21 evtkuj"><div class="section-content "><div><p>Bookworm foodies, we found a place that is perfect for grabbing a bite while enjoying your next big read. Ranging from fiction genre to non-fictional reads, Cafe Kathaa offers you a lot of interesting books to read. For the tech-savvy readers, they also have kindles on every table.</p><p>There is a sense of calm as soon as you enter the place. The place is done-up beautifully with vibrant colours and bright lights. The best thing about the ambience is that they have a wall with many potted plants. There is a beautiful outdoor space for those who want to bask in the sun and chill with your friends. Their indoors are also absolutely perfect to spend quiet time reading and sipping on your beverages.</p><p>As far as the food is concerned, there are many great options to pamper your taste-buds. Health freaks, this cafe also serves many healthy food and beverage options, We ordered the pineapple and ginger drink which was simply mind-blowing. We also tried the falafel burger platter which came with a dollop of hummus and Peri-Peri fries. We gave a miss to the normal sushi and tried their signature egg sushi. Unique and tasty, it made our day.</p><p>Pizza lovers, they have the authentic coconut and pineapple Hawaii pizza along with many other fruit pizzas. The apple crumble pizza is a must-try. If you are looking for reasonable food and a great ambience, Cafe Kathaa will meet all your expectations.</p><p dir="ltr"><b>Timings:</b> 10 AM to 10.30 PM (Monday to Thursday), 8 AM to 10.30 PM (Friday to Sunday)</p><p dir="ltr"><b>Price For Two:</b> INR 850 </p><p dir="ltr"><b>Google Rating: </b>4.2/5</p><p dir="ltr"><b>Social Handle:</b> <a id="outbound-link" target="_blank" href="https://www.instagram.com/cafekathaa/?hl=en&utm_source=LBB&ref=lbbpost">Instagram</a></p></div></div></div></section><section id="67848d5096d71b23c75b4170"><h2 class="styled-components__StyledSectionTitle-sc-w4s7c5-18 gOrzBX"><div class="">How To Reach</div></h2><div class="styled-components__StyledSectionContent-sc-w4s7c5-21 evtkuj"><div class="section-content "><div><p>Cafe Kathaa is well-connected by road and easily accessible from all parts of the city.
